principle: evaluate the ACTUAL registered intake geometry, its capture efficiency and the delivered mass flow with the admitted chain; never invent a design point, never invent or freeze a maximum intake area (A4-REG-01 stays OPEN)

the comparison is a NECESSARY condition: every requirement A5 uses is the A4 conservation requirement at its favorable limit (eta = 1 thruster, P_avail = HC-03 - P_nonHall,LB,eligible, energy inflow bound); a design that meets it establishes nothing; a design that misses it cannot meet the RFP thrust requirement at that state under any chemistry or transport

DS-F1-GRID.what: the F1 intake design grid: frontal area A in F1-P-16 {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5} m2 x L/d in {3, 5, 10, 20} x phi in {0.8, 0.9} (F1-P-18); the channel diameter d (F1-P-17) is collapsed because every TPMC output is d-invariant at fixed L/d (finding F1-02): 48 candidates
DS-F1-GRID.scenarios: the 10 F1 surface scenarios (alpha in {0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1} x {maxwell, cll}), theta 0
DS-F1-GRID.states: the 196 required states of the design-state set v2 (the F1 design-case reference h200_f150 is carried by the chain but is not a required state)
DS-F1-GRID.producer: abep_design::inputs::load_upstream_inputs (the admitted F7 consumer view of the sha-pinned F1 core: IF-A1 unit-area records x A, per-state F1 feasibility with its C-DRAG-RFP / MODEL_ERROR reasons carried unchanged)
DS-F1-GRID.role: information for the candidates outside DS-F1-ADMISSIBLE (label DESIGN_GRID_INFORMATION)

DS-F1-ADMISSIBLE.what: per scenario, the DS-F1-GRID candidates that are FEASIBLE_AT_STATE at every required state (F1 envelope feasibility: hard constraints C-CONV and C-DRAG-RFP), i.e. the intakes the admitted F7 chain can carry as one hardware across all states
DS-F1-ADMISSIBLE.area_limit_rule: if intake_effective_collection_area_max_m2 is registered with status FROZEN, candidates with A above it are excluded (OUTSIDE_REGISTERED_AREA_LIMIT); PROVISIONAL marks them without excluding; not registered today (A4-REG-01 OPEN), so nothing is excluded on area

DS-F7-PARETO.what: every member of the admitted F7 Pareto blocks (f7_pareto_blocks_v1.json.gz): a design vector (intake candidate, filter case, compressor design, plenum volume V, set pressure P_set) in its context (scenario, filter, wall case, P_set) with its context role (ARCHITECTURE_CONTEXT or REFERENCE_BOUND_FC00_NOT_ADMISSIBLE)
DS-F7-PARETO.why_sufficient: mdot_delivered_min_kgps is a maximized F7 objective, so within each context the largest statewise-minimum delivered flow over every feasible vector is attained by a Pareto member (weak dominance); dominated vectors are not registered designs

DS-F8.what: the F8 carried robust set (admissible hardware of A2 P-FLOW, carried unchanged; EMPTY today) and, per F7 member, its F8 status: ROBUST_MEMBER, F8_SURVIVOR_NOT_ROBUST (n_scenarios_feasible, infeasible_in and the per-scenario reasons of f8_study.scenario carried unchanged) or NOT_AN_F8_SURVIVOR; the F8 decomposition is carried unchanged

inputs.IN-A4: per state (harness order) from the A4 outcome of the same harness run: Phi_max(s), q_max(s), Phi_adm(s) = rho V, P_avail(s, AIR) = HC-03 - P_nonHall,LB,eligible(s, AIR), A_req(s, T) and mdot_req(T, P_avail) for T = HC-01 (12 mN) and HC-02 (25 mN); a state whose A4 AIR quantities are not evaluated is NOT_EVALUATED in A5 with the A4 codes
inputs.IN-ENV: per state: n_O, n_N2, n_O2, admitted V (the A4 IN-ENV inputs, already cross-checked against the mission run hook)
inputs.IN-F1: DS-F1-GRID records (abep_design::inputs::load_upstream_inputs); the F1 required state ids must equal the harness state ids as a set (every harness state has an F1 record of every candidate and scenario), otherwise MODEL_ERROR; A5 reports in harness order
inputs.IN-F7: the F7 Pareto members (pinned gz) and, for each, the admitted chain inputs it names (F1 records of its candidate and scenario, filter case, compressor plant, plenum of (V, wall))
inputs.IN-F8: the F8 study (pinned gz): carried_robust_set, survivors, scenario, and the F8 report decomposition_rust
inputs.IN-AREA-LIMIT: the A4 IN-AREA-LIMIT exactly as A4 reads it (intake_effective_collection_area_max_m2); A5 never reads an area limit from anywhere else and never supplies one
inputs.IN-HALL: the Hall envelope points of the AIR family as ingested by A1 / A2 (none today)

Q-AEFF.definition: the A4 effective collection area (B-FLOW area_definition) of design d. No spacecraft surface ahead of or beside the intake is registered (OQ-F78-04 open; H2-7 HI-05 / R01), so it reduces to the aperture's projected area at theta 0: A_eff(d) = A(d) (F1-P-16)
Q-AEFF.label: AREA_EFF_EQUALS_APERTURE_NO_SPACECRAFT_GEOMETRY_REGISTERED

Q-MDOT-CAP.definition: sum over O, N2, O2 of the forward-transmitted (captured) flow eta_c,i rho_i V A of the F1 IF-A1 record (direct TPMC, theta 0) of candidate d in scenario sc at state s; the species mass fractions are reported

definitions.eta_c: mdot_cap / (A sum_{O,N2,O2} n_i m_i V_adm): capture efficiency on the F1 species basis (the F1 / intake_tpmc definition, mass-weighted), with the admitted free stream
definitions.eta_tot: mdot_cap / (A Phi_adm): fraction of the total admitted free-stream mass flux (the unspeciated remainder counts as not captured)
definitions.eta_vs_bound: mdot_cap / (A Phi_max): fraction of the A4 favorable one-sided flux bound

Q-ACAP.definition: mdot_cap / Phi_max(s): the area an ideal (eta_cap = 1, Phi_max) collector would need to capture the same flow; the currency of the A4 required area

Q-MDOT-DEL.definition: delivered flow and its O / N2 / O2 mole fractions of F7 member h at state s after filter, compressor and plenum (steady), from the admitted chain: abep_gaspath::plenum_feed::intake_side and steady_sweep with abep_design::optimizer::plenum on the member's F1 records, one target P_set; the plenum / feed steady values are the admitted F7 reproduction of the governed Python reference capture (A2 R2; v8 PARITY_FAIL stands; no transient)
Q-MDOT-DEL.cross_check: fail closed: every state of the member is in domain (sweep bits 0) and the minimum over the F7 state list equals the member's committed mdot_delivered_min_kgps bit for bit; otherwise MODEL_ERROR

Q-MDOT-REQ-IN.definition: A4 K-MDOT-REQ at P_avail(s, AIR) + q_max(s) A(d): the smallest flow that could give T with the electric power plus the A4 bound on the energy the design's own captured gas carries in; it is below the A9.35 carried-forward value mdot_req(T, P_avail) (electric power only), which is reported alongside
Q-MDOT-REQ-IN.role: the binding flow requirement of L-CAP and L-DEL (favorable to the design, so a failure is robust)

L-AREA.basis: A4 B-THRUST at eta_cap = 1, Phi_max, q_max: necessary for any design of that area

L-CAP.test: mdot_cap(d, sc, s) >= mdot_req,in(d, s, T)
L-CAP.basis: B-FLOW mdot_jet <= mdot_cap with the design's TPMC capture

L-DEL.designs: failure: every DS-F7-PARETO member of the scenario, including the REFERENCE_BOUND_FC00_NOT_ADMISSIBLE contexts (favorable: no filter); pass: only an F8 robust member (DS-F8) - with the robust set EMPTY no L-DEL pass is ever claimed (GAS_PATH_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY, carried from A2)

L-HALL.test: information only: per state and Hall test, mdot of the smallest-flow AIR envelope point passing the test (at P_nonHall,LB) against the best mdot_cap and mdot_del; and the v1 envelope grid floor (MF-LO)
L-HALL.rule: never a verdict; the joint flow condition stays A2 NH-FLOW
L-HALL.today: NOT_EVALUATED (no AIR Hall envelope ingested; the AIR codes of the harness)

comparisons.requirements: T in {HC-01 = 12 mN (sustained), HC-02 = 25 mN (capability)}, both per state as in the v1 / A1 Hall point tests (A4 uses existence for T25 only for its own non-closure claim)

multipliers.k_cap(d, sc, s, T): mdot_req,in(d, s, T) / mdot_cap(d, sc, s)
multipliers.rule: the factor by which the design's area or flow must grow to meet the necessary condition (<= 1 passes); a scenario with no design of the set has no multiplier (NO_DESIGN_IN_SCENARIO); a delivered flow <= 0 at a state fails with an unbounded multiplier (reported null, INFINITE)

margins.per_state: per level and T: k_fav(s) = the minimum over scenarios of the best (smallest) design multiplier in that scenario, k_unfav(s) = the maximum over scenarios of that best multiplier, with the design and scenario attaining them
margins.worst_state: per level and T: the required state with the largest k_fav(s); reported with A_eff, eta_c, eta_tot, mdot_cap, mdot_del and the requirement there
margins.per_design: per design (and scenario): its worst state (largest multiplier), the multiplier there, the number of failing required states, and the values at the worst state
margins.required_multiplier: the per-level worst-state k_fav is the margin to closure of the registered design set (how far the best registered design is from the ideal necessary condition)

statewise.state_verdict: per (level, T, required AIR state): FAILS_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO iff in every scenario no design of the level's set passes (a scenario without designs fails); PASSES_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO iff in every scenario some admissible design passes (L-AREA / L-CAP only; information, nothing established); for L-DEL a non-failing state is NOT_ESTABLISHED_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY while DS-F8 is empty; otherwise SCENARIO_DEPENDENT (MISSING_EVIDENCE: DI-1.3 surface accommodation); NOT_EVALUATED when the state's A4 AIR inputs are not evaluated
statewise.one_hardware: per (level, T, scenario): the design set closes the level iff one design passes at every required state (A2: one hardware across all states); aggregated over scenarios: NECESSARY_CONDITION_MET_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO (information) / FAILS_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO / SCENARIO_DEPENDENT; reported, never a cell constraint (the per-state verdict carries the cell effect)

classification_effect.cell_constraint: at a required AIR_PRIMARY state s where some level (L-AREA, L-CAP, L-DEL) is FAILS_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO for T12 or T25, the layer (a) cell gains the constraint A5-NH-INTAKE: status NON_CLOSING, eligible_close false, eligible_non_close false, codes A5_<LEVEL>_BELOW_REQUIRED_<T> for every failing (level, T): A5_AREA_BELOW_REQUIRED_T12 / _T25, A5_CAPTURE_BELOW_REQUIRED_T12 / _T25, A5_DELIVERED_BELOW_REQUIRED_T12 / _T25, each of A9.31 sec. 21 category DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT
classification_effect.cell_status: a cell that is PHYSICS_NON_CLOSING by an eligible constraint (A4 CA4, an eligible v1 / A2 non-closure) stays so; otherwise it is NOT_DETERMINABLE and the A5 codes join its blocker list (C1 / C4 tallies, dominant-blocker order by category)
classification_effect.never_eligible: A5-NH-INTAKE never supports PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (C2 / CA4) and never closes (C3): A9.35 classifies a failing current design DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT. A registered spacecraft-envelope bound proving that no permissible intake can close is exactly A4 CA4 on a FROZEN intake_effective_collection_area_max_m2; none is registered (A4-REG-01 OPEN) and A5 adds no other route
classification_effect.no_effect: PASSES_IN_EVERY_SCENARIO, SCENARIO_DEPENDENT, NOT_ESTABLISHED_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY and NOT_EVALUATED add no constraint and no blocker
classification_effect.procedure: C0, CA4, C1, C2, C3, C4 unchanged (A2 / A4); A5 enters only through the per-cell constraint list of required AIR cells; XE_CONTINGENCY is NOT_APPLICABLE (stored Xe, no intake)
classification_effect.a2_a4_unchanged: A2 NH-FLOW (GAS_PATH_ROBUST_SET_EMPTY), the joint point conditions and every A4 verdict and code are computed exactly as before; the dry-run v1 record is the harness without A5

record.harness: harness v2 gains A5 additively: M1Inputs carries the A5 inputs, M1Outcome the A5 outcome, required AIR cells gain A5-NH-INTAKE by the rule above, and the v2 record gains a summary block intake_closure_a5

record.dry_run: abep-assess-closure --harness v2 --run-label M1_DRY_RUN_NOT_DECISIVE --out closure_run_m1_dryrun_v2.json: a NEW record; closure_run_m1_dryrun_v1.json stays immutable

fail_closed: any A5, A4, A2, A1 or v1 file whose sha256 differs, or a lock mismatch, refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR, exit 4)

an F1 state list that differs from the harness state list, a missing F1 record, an F7 member whose chain inputs are absent, an out-of-domain state of an F7 member or a statewise minimum that differs from the committed mdot_delivered_min_kgps refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR)

a non-finite or non-positive A, mdot_cap, Phi or requirement at an evaluated state refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR); a state whose A4 AIR inputs are not evaluated is NOT_EVALUATED, never a pass and never a failure
SYNTHETIC test inputs carry SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE and never appear in a committed record
verification: analytic: mdot_req,in at q = 0 equals the A4 mdot_req; the multipliers invert the tests (k <= 1 iff the test passes); A_cap,eq = A when mdot_cap = Phi_max A; eta_c = 1 for a synthetic record capturing the whole O / N2 / O2 flux
fail-closed: a state without evaluated A4 inputs is NOT_EVALUATED and adds nothing; a tampered pin refuses; an F7 cross-check mismatch refuses

classification: a synthetic design set that fails in every scenario adds A5-NH-INTAKE with DESIGN_VARIABLE_LIMIT codes and never PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING; scenario-dependent and passing sets add nothing; a FROZEN synthetic area limit excludes larger candidates and, below A_req, CA4 still decides first; XE untouched
determinism: identical inputs give a byte-identical record; the committed records regenerate byte for byte
determinism: no random input; closed-form comparisons over committed records and the admitted steady chain; BTreeMap order and fixed float formatting
change_control: any change after the lock is a new, dated addendum registered before the evaluation it governs; results seen under A5 cannot justify changing it. Registering A_eff,max (A4-REG-01, an owner / requirements item) or new design sets (an F1 / F7 / F8 regeneration) is an input change: the harness consumes it without a code change
